description: Bridson Poisson-disk sampling over the unit cube.
x-jarvis-example:
Method: Bridson
Bounds:
  radius: 0.1
  max_attempt: 30
  seed: 0
Variables:
  - name: x
    distribution:
      type: Flat
      parameters: {min: 0.0, max: 1.0, length: 1.0}

Bounds.description: Method-specific Bridson knobs. Closed: unknown keys are rejected.

radius.description: Poisson-disk minimum separation in unit-cube coordinates.

max_attempt.description: Bridson k: candidate attempts per accepted point.

max_worker.description: Optional worker hint for parallel proposal (runtime may ignore).
